editorial:
Imagine you are packing your bags for the American Dream, only to end up completely lost in the middle of nowhere. That is exactly what happens to this group of immigrants. Instead of landing in a big city, they find themselves stuck in a silent, empty forest. The vibe is pretty wild because these people decide that since they cannot find the United States, they will just build their own version of it right there in the woods. It is a funny, strange look at how people try to create a perfect society when they have nothing but their own imaginations and a few supplies.

You will really enjoy how the characters clash and cooperate as they make up their own laws and customs. The acting is natural and the comedy comes from how ridiculous their ideas become. While the pace slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff is worth it. If you are into quirky stories about human nature, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: At the end, the group realizes that their fake version of America is actually more honest than the real thing. They stop pretending to be something they are not and accept their new life in the forest. The twist is that they find a way back to civilization, but many of them choose to stay behind. They decide that peace and friendship are more important than chasing a dream in a foreign land.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves odd comedies and stories about building a new society.
